annotations.title: utilpeek: count word frequencies in a text

description: utilpeek: Count word and n-gram frequencies in a text. For scored keyphrases use text_keywords. Returns the most frequent words or 2-3 word n-grams (n-grams never cross punctuation) with count and share, dropping stop words (en, es, fr, de, pt, it, nl, or none), and optionally character counts. Typically under 0.3 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/keyword-extraction-api.html

case_sensitive.description: Count "Word" and "word" apart (default false: terms are lowercased).
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

include_numbers.description: Also count numeric tokens such as 2026 (default false).
include_numbers.title: Include Numbers

language.description: Stop-word list to drop (none = keep every word).
language.title: Language

min_length.description: Shortest word counted, in characters (1-50, default 1; single words only, ngram=1).
min_length.title: Min Length

ngram.description: Term length in words: 1 (default), 2 or 3; n-grams never span punctuation.
ngram.title: Ngram

remove_stopwords.description: Drop the stop words of `language` (default true).
remove_stopwords.title: Remove Stopwords

top_n.description: Most frequent terms to return (1-1000, default 50).
top_n.title: Top N

name: text_frequency

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
